## Overview

Growing up in a polyglot family in Bengaluru, I saw firsthand how language creates invisible barriers to opportunity. This project applies natural language processing and localization principles to build a chatbot that converses in vernacular languages, making digital tools reachable for underserved communities.

## What I Did

::: {.project-section}
<ul class="star-list">
<li><strong>Situation:</strong> Many people in India — especially in informal and gig-economy work — lack access to services and information because interfaces are overwhelmingly English-first.</li>
<li><strong>Task:</strong> Design and build a chatbot that understands and responds in vernacular languages, lowering the barrier to digital participation.</li>
<li><strong>Action:</strong> Integrated NLP APIs for intent recognition and multilingual response generation; designed conversation flows tuned for non-English speakers; tested with real-world phrasing patterns common in local languages.</li>
<li><strong>Result:</strong> A working prototype that demonstrates how technology can be localized for accessibility — aligning with my broader commitment to social equity through tech.</li>
</ul>
:::
